name: Self-host monaco-editor for the admin code editor
description:
## Why?

The admin's code editor (the Theme editor code view and, from , the partner addon Kódy tab) downloads Monaco from cdn.jsdelivr.net at runtime. If jsDelivr is slow, blocked or down, the editor stays on "Loading…" with no message, and partners cannot see or edit their code. It is also a supply-chain dependency on a third-party CDN, and the CDN serves Monaco 0.55.1 while the admin declares ^0.52.0 (0.52.2 installed), so what runs is not what we test. Raised in the review of  as a product/SRE decision and split out so it does not block that PR.

## What?

Monaco ships with the admin's own assets and loads from the admin's domain. No editor makes a request to a third-party CDN, and the Monaco version that runs is the one the admin declares and tests.

## Acceptance criteria

The Theme editor code view and the addon Kódy tab load the editor with no request to cdn.jsdelivr.net (or any other third-party host).

The Monaco version served matches the version locked in the admin's dependencies.

With cdn.jsdelivr.net blocked in the browser, both editors load and are editable.

Theme editor features keep working: syntax highlighting, HTML/JS validation markers, closing-tag completion, Shoptet placeholder autocomplete.

A page that has no code editor open (e.g. the addon detail with Kódy never opened) does not download Monaco.

## Technical notes

> Generated by Claude Opus 5.5, on 2026-10-05

- The admin React editor is Core/components/CodeEditor (moved from ThemeEditor in CZ3TDR1-564). Consumers: ThemeEditor EditCodeSection, Form.CodeEditorField, the PartnerServiceAdd Codes tab.
- @monaco-editor/react 4.7.0 uses @monaco-editor/loader 1.7.0, whose default config points at jsDelivr; the repo sets no loader config.
- Admin assets are built by Vite into public/admin/react/dist; Monaco's workers and AMD loader would join the deployed admin assets (deploy/infra impact, size increase to be measured).
- The admin CSP sets no script-src or worker-src today, so CSP is not a blocker.
- Owners: ThemeEditor is @shoptet/storefront-team (CODEOWNERS); Core components have no explicit owner.
